inspiration.observed_pattern: An INSERT ... SELECT creates staged surrogate IDs by adding a global ROW_NUMBER window to the greater of two scalar MAX values, while joining batch rows and cross joining a one-row context source.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a label-allocation staging load. Active batch items are joined to their batch groups and a single allocation context row, then receive deterministic IDs above both the existing generated-ID maximum and source-item maximum. The source word-list schema, names, values, and SQLite operators are not copied.

fixture_notes: Existing generated ID 100 and source item ID 90 establish an offset of 100. Three active batch items receive IDs 101 through 103 in group/item order; an inactive item is excluded. The canonical-item comparison emits one primary flag without relying on source boolean syntax.
determinism_notes: Batch codes, group IDs, item IDs, source maxima, active flags, labels, one-row context, window ordering, and final ordering are fixed; there are no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE split_batches (batch_code VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY, group_id INT NOT NULL, active TINYINT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE batch_items (batch_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, item_id INT NOT NULL, canonical_item_id INT NOT NULL, label_text VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, active TINYINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (batch_code, item_id))
CREATE TABLE source_items (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, source_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE allocation_context (context_id INT PRIMARY KEY, context_name VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE generated_labels (generated_id INT PRIMARY KEY, group_id INT NOT NULL, item_id INT NOT NULL, label_text VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, is_primary TINYINT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO generated_labels (generated_id, group_id, item_id, label_text, is_primary) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.group_id, i.item_id) + GREATEST(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(generated_id) FROM generated_labels), 0), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(item_id) FROM source_items), 0)) AS generated_id, b.group_id, i.item_id, i.label_text, CASE WHEN i.item_id = i.canonical_item_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM split_batches AS b INNER JOIN batch_items AS i ON i.batch_code = b.batch_code CROSS JOIN allocation_context AS c WHERE b.active = 1 AND i.active = 1 AND c.context_id = 1
SELECT generated_id, group_id, item_id, label_text, is_primary FROM generated_labels ORDER BY generated_id

checks.sql: SELECT generated_id, group_id, item_id, label_text, is_primary FROM generated_labels ORDER BY generated_id
